''See also: [[Altavian Arelius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Altavian [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a member of the core bloodline of [[Arelius family|House Arelius]], a family that previously governed much of the [[Rosegold continent]] under the rule of the late [[Tiberian Arelius|Monarch Tiberian Arelius]]. A man in his early thirties with nearly white blond hair and blue eyes, he possesses a calm, meditative demeanor. Physically, he is comparable in height to [[Lindon]] but has a leaner build suited for running and long-reaching strikes. During a competition, he faced [[Yerin|Yerin Arelius]] in a match where he utilized silver [[Enforcement]] and a [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] blade. Despite his high standing as a direct descendant, he faced significant pressure from [[Yerin]]'s combat prowess. Altavian is also identified as a cousin to [[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Altavian wields a [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] blade during combat. He has been seen blazing with a silver full-body [[Enforcement]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A member of the core [[House]] bloodline, Altavian is a partner to [[Veris Arelius|Veris]] and her cousin. He acts as an informant by explaining the [[Diamond Veins elixir]] to others.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Altavian is a member of the [[Arelius family|House Arelius]] team and serves as [[Veris Arelius|Veris]]'s partner. He is also the cousin of [[Veris Arelius]]. Additionally, he has had interactions with [[Yerin]], which included attacking her and explaining the [[Diamond Veins elixir]] to her.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Altavian is a [[sword]] artist who specializes in [[Enforcer techniques]]. He utilizes razor-sharp nails as his [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Altavian [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a bloodline member of the core [[House]] and serves as [[Veris Arelius|Veris]]' partner on the Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius team. A [[sword]] artist specializing in [[Enforcer techniques]], he utilizes razor-sharp nails as his [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] and is considered a potential fighter in the [[tournament]]. During an encounter, he leaped over a maze to attack [[Yerin]] with his [[Goldsteel|goldsteel]] blade while blazing with a silver full-body [[Enforcement]]. Following this engagement, Altavian provided [[Yerin]] with an explanation regarding the [[Diamond Veins elixir]].}}
